scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind design a well-formatted document.
Title: states the topic of a page or slide. Font: changes how writing appears.
Colour: helps emphasise important information. Picture: can explain an idea visually. Layout: arranges content clearly.
Make a one-page paper example about your school or a Ghanaian festival. Include title, font and colour; present it clearly to a partner.
